expectations.buyer: Rhine-dependent manufacturers, freight forwarders, and multimodal capacity providers
expectations.pain: Low water makes spot freight capacity scarce and exposes production plans to volatile transport constraints
expectations.strongestIncumbent: Forwarder contingency contracts, inventory buffers, rail/truck procurement, low-draft fleets, and bilateral capacity reservations
expectations.biggestRisk: A tradable option may fail on capacity commitment, trigger basis, regulation, correlated scarcity, and incumbent forwarder relationships
